design: Themed weather control portraits. Wind uses these new portraits; precipitation reuses the existing raincoat and cold-weather character layers. The option renderer composites intensity cues over the selected character.

assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: character layer for a small weather-choice button in a children's app. Use the supplied princess as the exact identity and warm shaded 2D storybook style reference. Create one waist-up portrait of the SAME brown-haired, brown-eyed princess wearing her pink-and-gold dress and heart crown. She smiles into a breeze, leaning slightly, one hand gently holding the crown; her long wavy hair and a pink scarf flow clearly to the right. Large expressive face centered, clear silhouette, entire crown, hands and flowing hair within frame with 10 percent margins. No scenery, no cloud, no wind symbols, no lettering, no border. Background must be a perfectly uniform pure green #00FF00 for the existing project chroma-key compositing pipeline; no green in the subject, no checkerboard, no shadow on backdrop. Preserve her face and illustration rendering, no flat vector icon style.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: character layer for a small weather-choice button in a children's app. Use the supplied Heartsping / Teenie Ping image as exact character identity and softly glossy, richly shaded 3D toy rendering reference. Create one waist-up portrait of the SAME cute pink Heartsping, with huge plum eyes, forehead pink curl, white-pink long ear-like hair and pink heart tips. She smiles into a breeze, leaning slightly, her long pink locks and a soft pink scarf flow clearly to the right, one hand holding her scarf at the chest. Large expressive face centered, clear silhouette, entire head and flowing locks within frame with 10 percent margins. Keep her pink heart dress and gold-edged heart pendant. No scenery, no cloud, no wind symbols, no lettering, no border. Background must be perfectly uniform pure green #00FF00 for the existing project chroma-key compositing pipeline; no green in subject, no checkerboard, no shadow on backdrop. Preserve the glossy 3D rendering and face, no flat vector icon style.

production.characterBackground: True alpha extracted from generated chroma-key masters during asset preparation; no runtime keying.
